title: cochlearia officinalis var. pyrenaica
intro: Cochlearia officinalis var. pyrenaica, commonly known as Alpine Bittercress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and skin problems, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Bittercress include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
